# Your first practice folder

Welcome to this quickstart! This quickstart will help you get started quickly. Let us begin getting started.

## First local run

An environment variable is a named setting for the current shell. DEMO_NOTES_HOME tells these commands where to keep your practice notes. Set it before running the commands; a new shell needs its own assignment.

```powershell
$env:DEMO_NOTES_HOME = "./demo-notes"
demo-notes init
demo-notes check
```

The init command creates the practice folder. The check command confirms it is ready. Expect `Ready: 0 notes`: ready means the folder is usable; zero notes is normal before you have added any.

## Run in a new shell

This section can be read on its own. In PowerShell, set the practice folder for this shell, then initialize and check it:

```powershell
$env:DEMO_NOTES_HOME = "./demo-notes"
demo-notes init
demo-notes check
```

Expect `Ready: 0 notes`. The variable selects the local folder; setting it here makes that folder available to both commands in this shell.
